capabilities: Expand selections through Markdown structural layers
Shrink selections back through expansion history
Match brackets, quotes and inline Markdown delimiters
Handle fenced code blocks and nested LaTeX math
disambiguation: Not a text-expansion or snippet plugin; it only changes the current editor selection.
extras: No default hotkeys are assigned, so users must bind shortcuts in Settings → Hotkeys. Interface strings follow Obsidian's language, with English fallback and Simplified Chinese.
motivation: The author wanted selections to grow or shrink progressively without the user reaching for the mouse.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to progressively grow or shrink a selection through Markdown structure without reaching for the mouse.
summary: Adds IDE-style Expand and Shrink Selection commands that grow or shrink text selections through Markdown-aware structural layers.
